statusNote: offline handoff draft: not imported into Unity, not checked on devices, not final game art
pivotSpace: pixel-edge coordinates, origin at the bottom-left corner of one frame cell, x right, y up
frameLayout: one horizontal strip per animation; frame i occupies x = i*cell.w .. (i+1)*cell.w, full height; no padding

flip.note: flip once on the parent transform of all player layers (or on a single sprite's renderer), never per layer; path tiles and UI pieces are never flipped

license.art: every PNG here was made for Bible Survivors: player parts are cut from the project's own 02 drafts and edited by hand; everything else is drawn by this folder's scripts from src/palette_v03.json. No third-party images, traces or reference art.

fonts.use: review boards and UI mock-up text only; no export PNG contains font glyphs
